comparator.sourceNotes: Exact Dutch/fulltime BA56824 Art History at Radboud. Dutch and English teaching; Dutch-taught assessments Dutch, English-taught courses allow Dutch/English. Degree180EC, supported subset170EC only. Twelve required5EC B1courses60; B2five named required courses30 plus two fixed15ECArtsminors30; B3Paris10 repeated is excluded from distinct subset, one nonoverlapping5ECchoice instantiated as AmericanArt, requiredcareer/PPO5, thesis10 and genuinefree30=50 distinct. Free space is bachelor broadening outside own programme; foreign courses need prior approval. No namedminor imposed. B1mentoring/PPO0,RADAr0,B2mentoring/PPO0 included separately; attendance all seminars/mentorship, satisfactory component assessments; ordinary45ECBSA. Paris requires passed nineteenth-century modernity OR twentieth-century art for2021+ entrants. CurrentOERArticle10 permits thesis after Florence OR Paris, overriding catalogue older both requirement. Thesis has preparatory meetings, topic/method agreement, supervisor/second reader and independent research. Currentcareer/PPO consolidates portfolio work, not an extra beyond180. No study-abroad replacement or resit-only Florence/Kunstwerelden mixed into ordinary route. Current adopted2026–27 programme OER Article5 p7 repeats LET-KGB340 Paris10EC in B2 and B3. Count once:60B1+60B2+50distinctB3=170EC. Need authoritative cohort-specific10EC replacement/repeat-credit rule establishing one ordinary current180EC route. Article7 pp8–9 grants only resits for Florence LET-KGB225 and Kunstwerelden LET-KGB711; it does not reinstate them as ordinary new-entrant requirements. Future2027–30 pages instead prescribe Florence10 and Kunstwerelden5, while currentB3 has career/PPO5 and a restricted5EC choice. Neither the old2025–26 combined120EC/minor40 structure nor conditional Article6 abroad route can silently repair this. Current catalogue Paris points back to OER, without a distinct repeat unit. This is a positive published-document discrepancy, not transient source inaccessibility. Stage 2 16 November: use exactly the 170 distinct supported EC; Paris is counted once. Unknown 10 EC are excluded, not converted to electives. No future Florence/Kunstwerelden or conditional study-abroad repair is assumed.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Three independently supported programmes: closest art/visual inquiry, heritage/public cultural power and environmental visual humanities. All retain an actual art/heritage anchor. Pairwise differences arise from substantive priorities, not substitutions to meet a threshold.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: No dedicated medieval visual-art survey is established by the selected UCR courses.
UCR modern art gives relevant period connections but is placed at the stronger twentieth-century relationship; no separate nineteenth-century survey is inferred.
No equivalent medieval-art field excursion/seminar is supplied.
Both examine Greek material/visual culture in historical and community context; Radboud additionally surveys Roman archaeology, while UCR focuses on early democracy.
No dedicated late-antique-to-Renaissance architecture sequence is supplied.
No dedicated modern global architecture survey is supplied.
Both study Renaissance visual art and historical context. UCR emphasizes Italian/Mediterranean/global exchange; Radboud includes broader European Renaissance/Baroque chronology.
Both study twentieth-century and contemporary visual art, movements and interpretation. UCR emphasizes museums/display and begins in the late nineteenth century.
Paris excursion and sustained situated study are distinct from UCR museum/visual inquiry.
No dedicated Asian architectural history/globalization sequence is supplied.
Native American cultural/visual work is a real contribution, not the external American Art survey.
Ethics or general philosophical reasoning does not establish a dedicated aesthetics curriculum.

Both develop actual visual analysis and historically grounded art inquiry. Radboud explicitly introduces art history as a discipline; UCR combines close painting analysis/on-site research with a broad Western art survey.
Art/literary research contributes writing, but no separate course is asserted as this first-year art-history seminar.
General visual analysis and myth do not establish the specific Christian/profane iconography and source sequence.
Both study the development and use of art-historical interpretive methods and historiography. Detailed theoretical selections and assessments differ.
Broad media-technology history does not establish dedicated photographic history and interpretation.
Required independent art-history thesis and supervision are distinct from scheduled methods/projects; optional UCR research remains additional to 180 EC.

Both examine how visual representation makes human/environment relations meaningful using environmental-humanities interpretation. Radboud specializes in seventeenth-century Dutch landscape images; UCR spans wider historical and contemporary image/film/sound contexts.
Two permitted whole Faculty of Arts minors remain restricted choice, with no invented selected subject package.
Both develop reflection, academic/personal competencies and future direction. UCR places its civic/academic development in Year 1; Radboud provides a final history-specific career/portfolio course.
Genuine 30-EC open study remains uninstantiated and is not assigned invented subject correspondence.

notes.text: UCR combines art history, archaeology, heritage and visual-media inquiry. Radboud supplies a more extensive art/architecture chronology, dedicated iconography, photography and excursions, and a required art-history thesis. The heritage and environmental programmes are broader related directions, not Radboud specialisations.

audience.programmeDescription: Art History at Radboud studies artworks, architecture and visual culture in their historical contexts, from antiquity to the present. It combines visual analysis, art-historical theories and methods, museum visits and independent research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers art history and visual culture, with related programmes in heritage/cultural power and environmental visual humanities. All contain substantial art and archaeological/heritage study. Radboud offers more extensive period and architecture study, dedicated iconography/photography, excursions and an independent art-history thesis. Its adopted table repeats the same Paris course; the unverified 10 EC are excluded from this qualified comparison.

curriculum.limitation: The degree is 180 EC. This list accounts for 170 distinct EC because the same 10-EC Paris course appears in both year 2 and year 3. The remaining 10 EC need clarification. Future Florence and Kunstwerelden courses are not treated as current replacements. This is a partial list, not a complete degree pathway. Required first-year mentoring, the Dutch academic-language diagnostic and second-year personal/professional development add no credits. Attendance applies to mentoring and seminars.

comparisonScope.assessed: The 170 distinct EC supported by the ordinary Art History requirements, including 30 EC of restricted Arts minor study and 30 EC of genuine open study, compared with three complete 180-EC UCR programmes.

acceptance.claim: Actual UCR art, archaeological/heritage and visual-method study supports a broader Art History comparison and two evidenced related directions, without reproducing the complete external architecture/period, excursion or thesis formation.
acceptance.challengeMethod: Separately identified same-AI source-first final pass against actual adopted OER/current UCR content and exact finished records, not separate human or agent approval.

uncertainties.fact: The same 10-EC Paris code is repeated in the adopted ordinary B2/B3 tables. Only 170 distinct EC are supported; the other required 10 EC and their role remain unverified.

adverseResolutions.resolution: An authoritative correction replaces the repeated entry with a distinct art/architectural period, methods or practical course.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: The unknown study stays excluded and may extend stated specialist gaps. It cannot remove the confirmed historical/method core or the actual substantial UCR art/visual response.

adverseResolutions.resolution: A genuinely distinct advanced Paris requirement or permitted choice explains the extra 10 EC.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: Its content and separate credit remain unverified and unmatched. The limited broader academic claim does not promise Paris/field or full-degree equivalence and survives.
